title: Device-stable continuous scale input dynamics and takeover lifecycle

scope.subject: Productize the existing System=1 to Surface=5 continuous coordinate with normalized WheelEvent units, reversible gesture sessions, immediate direction takeover, boundary idempotence, and navigation-authority cancellation

research_summary: The repository already has one continuous scale coordinate and one UniverseApp input authority. Browser WheelEvent supplies deltaMode but deliberately does not standardize physical device magnitude, so the missing layer is a small deterministic adapter: normalize line/page units into CSS-pixel distance, cap individual samples to bound coalesced or stalled delivery, preserve every signed sample directly in the real scale coordinate, and reset gesture-local evidence on reversal or higher-priority navigation takeover. Existing camera-controls and YEIS wheel ownership remain disabled; no inertia loop, queue, second controller, or phase-step threshold is introduced.

sources.finding: WheelEvent deltaMode defines pixel, line, and page units; product input must convert these units before mapping distance while retaining the signed delta.
Wheel delta units vary by deltaMode and browser/device, so raw deltaY is not a stable scale-distance input.
The installed camera-controls remains the sole product-world camera executor; its wheel action stays disabled while programmatic continuous coordinates update it.
Pinned MIT YEIS remains the large-scale renderer/navigation authority; product scale input must not add another camera or physics authority.

search_ladder.conclusion: Keep the selected Personal Universe/YEIS navigation product and extend its existing coordinator instead of replacing the universe stack.
Keep the single R3F host and React event boundary; normalization happens before the existing coordinate update.
Reuse UniverseApp as the sole navigation/input coordinator and retain existing takeover/cancellation entry points.
Reuse camera-controls only as the camera executor and implement a small pure WheelEvent unit adapter because camera-controls wheel physics is intentionally not an authority here.

candidates.name: Pure WheelEvent normalization and gesture session on the existing scale coordinator
candidates.license: project orchestration over existing MIT stack
candidates.reason: Preserves the real 1..5 coordinate and sole input/camera authority while adding only missing browser-unit and gesture-lifecycle semantics.

candidates.name: Re-enable camera-controls wheel dolly and damping
candidates.reason: It would create a second wheel/camera authority, add post-release motion, and cannot own cross-renderer semantic scale boundaries.

candidates.name: Discrete accumulated phase threshold and queued animation
candidates.reason: Quantizes the coordinate, delays reversal behind stale work, and makes boundary input observable as hidden queued mutations.

coverage_matrix.capability: Mouse notch and high-resolution trackpad produce comparable direct scale distance
coverage_matrix.decision: Normalize deltaMode to CSS-pixel-equivalent distance, then apply a documented bounded transfer function to every sample.

coverage_matrix.capability: Rapid reversal and takeover supersede old gesture state immediately
coverage_matrix.decision: Track signed gesture direction/epoch only for evidence and reset it on reversal, Search/Journey/deep-link/manual takeover.

coverage_matrix.capability: System and Surface boundaries are idempotent with immediate outward recovery
coverage_matrix.decision: Clamp the one coordinate, emit boundary evidence without mutating it, and let the next opposite sample move immediately.

decision.rationale: Extend the existing pure scale helpers and UniverseApp handler. Normalize WheelEvent units and map bounded signed distance directly to the 1..5 coordinate. Gesture state never drives autonomous frames; it only records segmentation and is invalidated on reversal or authority takeover.
decision.fallback: If a browser reports pathological deltas, cap only the individual delivered sample while preserving its sign and subsequent samples; never introduce inertia, a hidden queue, or phase-step accumulation.
